def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    face_value = 10000
    coupon_rate = 0.05
    discount_rate = 0.04
    years_to_maturity = 5
    annual_coupon = face_value * coupon_rate

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    present_value_coupons = sum(
        annual_coupon / ((1 + discount_rate) ** year)
        for year in range(1, years_to_maturity + 1)
    )
    present_value_face_value = face_value / ((1 + discount_rate) ** years_to_maturity)
    bond_value = present_value_coupons + present_value_face_value

    # Return the answer rounded to the nearest integer
    return round(bond_value)
